name: datadog
description: Datadog observability from the terminal for Oh-My-Pi via the Datadog 'pup' CLI (DataDog/pup): logs, metrics, traces/APM, monitors, incidents, dashboards, SLOs, synthetics, RUM, security/audit, CI test visibility, and LLM/agent observability. Ships ONE broad 'datadog' skill that drives pup (which embeds Datadog's ~30 domain skills/subagents) instead of flooding OMP with individual skills. The installer sets up the pup CLI + authentication (OAuth or DD_API_KEY/DD_APP_KEY).
